parameters.content:
## Booking Guard 1: deposit, access reminders, weather hold, at-risk alert
Runs every hour on your Bookings sheet. Sends the deposit request (repeat no-show clients get a non-refundable note), the 48h and 24h reminders that ask the customer to confirm water, power, keys and parking, the weather-hold message that moves rather than forfeits the deposit, and alerts you when a booking inside 12 hours has no access confirmation.

**Setup**
1. Create a Google Sheet with tabs Bookings and Report using the CSV headers in the sheet-templates folder; paste its ID into the Config node (sheetId).
2. Fill in the Config node: business name, owner email, time zone offset (for example -05:00), channel (sms or email), deposit amount and your own Stripe/PayPal payment link, notice hours.
3. Attach credentials on nodes with a warning icon: Google Sheets OAuth2, SMTP, and Twilio (HTTP Basic Auth: Account SID / Auth Token) if you use SMS.
4. Execute once with test rows, then activate.
5. Bookings.date must be YYYY-MM-DD and time 24h HH:MM (format the columns as plain text).
6. To trigger the weather message, type yes in the weather_hold column of the affected rows.
